From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + availability for Alex Jennings (Infra Lead)

11:00–12:00 PT on Thu works for me — please book.

Role & scope (short):
- This hire will own inference-serving reliability and performance for multi-tenant hosted APIs (hosted + dedicated). Primary focus: production runtime, autoscaling policies, cost/per-token optimizations, rollout safety, and cross-region failover. Secondary: partnering with model & infra teams on quantization/compilation tradeoffs.

Leveling signals (Staff vs Senior):
- Senior: owns significant subsystem or feature (e.g., KV cache improvements, batching strategy); demonstrates ownership through one full production rollout; technical depth on one area (e.g., kernel-level performance tuning) and can mentor peers.
- Staff: shapes system architecture across services (e.g., global routing/fallback), drives cross-team initiatives that materially reduce latency/cost, routinely influences roadmap/prioritization, and provides strong product/exec communication.

Interview focus areas for the 60m loop:
- 40m system design: design a multi-tenant low-latency inference serving layer; probe for tradeoffs (consistency vs availability, caching strategies, batching).
- 20m deep-dive: pick one production project from the resume; go deep on metrics, failure modes, rollout plan, and postmortem learnings.

Scoring guidance (attached): use hiring_scorecard.docx — weight system design 50%, deep-dive 35%, leadership & communication 15%. For leveling: look for cross-team scope and product impact for Staff.

I'll attach a short rubric and a suggested question list. Aditya — if you can act as the independent evaluator, please focus on probing breadth for leveling signals and consistency in candidate answers across interviews.

Attachments: hiring_scorecard.docx (scorecard & rubric)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Lopez <sarah@talentloop.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + availability for Alex Jennings (Infra Lead)

Confirming I'll join as the independent evaluator for the 11:00–12:00 PT loop today. Thanks for the context, Marissa — that scope aligns with what I expected. A couple of pragmatic notes for the loop:

1) Calibration targets:
- Senior: demonstrated ownership of a single subsystem with measured improvements (latency or cost) and clear metrics pre/post; comfortable implementing and shipping optimizations with an engineering team.
- Staff: multi-service impact, led cross-org initiatives, and experience defining tradeoffs that drove product-level decisions.

2) Suggested probe list (I will use these selectively):
- System design: ask candidate to sketch request path for a multi-tenant inference request; what are the hot-path optimizations? How do you manage KV cache invalidation across replicas?
- Rollouts: describe a rollout plan for a quantized model that regresses tail latency for 5% of customers — how do you detect, mitigate, and rollback?
- Metrics & SLOs: what metrics would you track (p95 latency, p99 tail, token cost per request, error budget), and how would you instrument them?
- Ownership & tradeoffs: a time they had to choose lower latency vs lower cost — how did they reason and communicate?

3) Scoring: I'll use Marissa's scorecard and add a short leveling note at the end of my feedback form (explicitly call out cross-team influence and measurable impact).

Olga — please send calendar invite with the meeting link and add the hiring_scorecard.docx to the invite. Alex — see you shortly.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao | Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
